findings.title: Food properly labeled; original container.
findings.comment: It was observed that there is not any allergen labeling on items throughout the breakfast buffet. According to the 2022 FDA Food Code, there needs to be allergen labeling on all buffet food items or bulk food items that are available for consumer self-service. Every food item on the buffet is labeled with the name of the food. If the allergen is not in the name of the food, the allergen needs to be listed for consumers to be aware of. This can be accomplished through a poster, on each individual item or display case, or as a QR code. Ensure that all buffet foods are labeled with the major allergens they contain by next routine inspection.
findings.citation_text: 3-602.11(C) Food Labels. (C) Bulk FOOD that is available for CONSUMER self-dispensing shall be prominently labeled with the following information in plain view of the CONSUMER: (1) The manufacturer's or processor's label that was provided with the FOOD; or (2) A card, sign, or other method of notification that includes the information specified under Subparagraphs (B)(1), (2), (5) and (6) of this section.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.comment: The handwashing sink in the kitchen was observed to not have any paper towels at it at the start of the inspection. CORRECTED- An employee replaced the paper towels. Ensure that each handwashing sink always has a supply of individual, disposable towels to allow for the proper use of a barrier during handwashing.
findings.citation_text: 6-301.12 Hand Drying Provision. Each HANDWASHING SINK or group of adjacent HANDWASHING SINKS shall be provided with: (A) Individual, disposable towels.

findings.title: Single use/single service articles are properly stored and used.
findings.comment: REPEAT- There are bowls in the buffet area that are observed to have the food contact surface exposed to contamination. Ensure that these bowls are inverted or covered to protect the food- and lip-contact surfaces from contamination.
findings.citation_text: 4-904.11(A) Kitchenware and Tableware. (A) SINGLE-SERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES and cleaned and SANITIZED UTENSILS shall be handled, displayed, and dispensed so that contamination of FOOD- and lip-contact surfaces is prevented.

findings.title: Thermometers provided & accurate
findings.comment:
4-204.112: In the back two door cooler, there was not an air thermometer to measure the air temperature of the unit. CORRECTED- The manager placed a thermometer in the unit. Ensure that all hot or refrigerated storage units have an air thermometer in them to accurately track the temperature of them. 

 (A) In refrigerated or hot FOOD storage unit, TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICE shall be located to measure air temperature.

findings.title: Single-use/single-service articles: properly stored and used
findings.comment:
4-904.11: There are to-go containers on the counter in the breakfast area that are being stored with the food-contact surface exposed to contamination. Ensure that these containers have a cover placed over them to protect them from contamination or are inverted. Single service articles and utensils need to be stored in a manner that protect them from contamination

(A) cleaned and SANITIZED UTENSILS shall be handled, displayed, and dispensed to prevent FOOD- and lip-contact surface contamination.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.12: The wall around the knives and magnetic knife strips is observed to be soiled with food splash. Ensure that this wall is cleaned and maintained cleaned to avoid contamination to the knives that are stored on the knife strips. Physical facilities should be cleaned as often as necessary to maintain them clean. 

(A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing.
